ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE NAME = 'TraSVat_InsUpdDel' AND xtype = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.TraSVat_InsUpdDel;

-- ============================================= -- Create date: 2018.07.24 -- Description: Projekt MetodaKasowa -- Podczas dodawania do TraVat dodawany jest podstawowy związany TraSVat -- =============================================
CREATE TRIGGER [CDN].[TraSVat_InsUpdDel] ON [CDN].[TraSVat] FOR INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE AS BEGIN -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from -- interfering with SELECT statements. SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- Insert statements for trigger here if exists(select * from inserted where inserted.TSV_subGIDLp > 1) or exists(select * from deleted where deleted.TSV_subGIDLp > 1) BEGIN UPDATE cdn.TraSVAT SET TSV_NettoP=(select TRV_NettoP from cdn.TraVAT where TRV_GIDTyp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDTyp,deleted.TSV_GIDTyp) and TRV_GIDNumer=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDNumer,deleted.TSV_GIDNumer) and TRV_GIDlp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDlp,deleted.TSV_GIDlp))-(select isnull(sum(b.TSV_NettoP),0) from cdn.TraSVAT as b where b.TSV_GIDTyp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDTyp,deleted.TSV_GIDTyp) and b.TSV_GIDNumer=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDNumer,deleted.TSV_GIDNumer) and b.TSV_GIDlp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDlp,deleted.TSV_GIDlp) and b.TSV_SubGIDLp>1), TSV_VATP=(select TRV_VATP from cdn.TraVAT where TRV_GIDTyp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDTyp,deleted.TSV_GIDTyp) and TRV_GIDNumer=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDNumer,deleted.TSV_GIDNumer) and TRV_GIDlp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDlp,deleted.TSV_GIDlp))-(select isnull(sum(b.TSV_VATP),0) from cdn.TraSVAT as b where b.TSV_GIDTyp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDTyp,deleted.TSV_GIDTyp) and b.TSV_GIDNumer=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDNumer,deleted.TSV_GIDNumer) and b.TSV_GIDlp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDlp,deleted.TSV_GIDlp) and b.TSV_SubGIDLp>1) from cdn.trasvat as a LEFT OUTER JOIN inserted on inserted.TSV_GIDTyp=a.TSV_GIDTyp and inserted.TSV_GIDNumer=a.TSV_GIDNumer and inserted.TSV_GIDlp=a.TSV_GIDlp and inserted.TSV_subGIDLp > 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN deleted on deleted.TSV_GIDTyp=a.TSV_GIDTyp and deleted.TSV_GIDNumer=a.TSV_GIDNumer and deleted.TSV_GIDlp=a.TSV_GIDlp and deleted.TSV_subGIDLp > 1 where a.TSV_GIDTyp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDTyp,deleted.TSV_GIDTyp) and a.TSV_GIDNumer=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDNumer,deleted.TSV_GIDNumer) and a.TSV_GIDlp=isnull(inserted.TSV_GIDlp,deleted.TSV_GIDlp) AND a.TSV_SubGIDLp=1
-- Sprawdzenie poprawności operacji IF @@error <> 0 BEGIN RAISERROR('Wystąpił błąd podczas modyfikacji rekord tabeli CDN.TraSVat.', 16, 1) ROLLBACK TRAN SET NOCOUNT ON RETURN END END
SET NOCOUNT OFF END
